description: This is a JUnit test class for validating the behavior of XML configuration files and module compatibility within the OpenMRS project. It contains parameterized tests that generate various XML configurations and verify their validity according to specific rules regarding versioning, module loading, and resource paths.

classes.name: ModuleConfigDTDTest_V1_6
classes.description: Test class for validating XML configuration files and module dependencies in OpenMRS, focusing on version compatibility and resource inclusion rules.

methods.name: validXmlConditionalResourcesWithVersion

methods.description: Checks that missing module ID causes validation to fail.
